newsitem.title: USA: Paper Brent steady to weaker in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Paper Brent steady to weaker in late U.S. trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil was steady to a shade weaker in late U.S. paper trading on Thursday, traders said.
Six partial August cargoes totalling 1,400 lots traded, twice at $17.73, once at $17.74 and three times at $17.75, going out at $17.74-77 a barrel, traders said.
August Brent closed at $17.77 a barrel on London's IPE. September settled at $17.90.
Intermonth spreads were subdued, with both July/August and August/September talked at minus 17/15 cents a barrel.
September/October was pegged around minus 13/11 cents.
